critical_issues: TypeScript type error in frontend/src/app/(app)/tasks/list/page.tsx: `<SortIconStatic k="due_date" />` and `<SortIconStatic k="created_at" />` are called with a `k` prop, but the `SortIconStatic` function signature accepts zero props — it takes no arguments at all. The function only returns a static `<span>` and ignores any props. This will fail at compile time with a TS2322 error, and even if TypeScript is bypassed, the `k` prop is silently dropped. Compare with the correct pattern in frontend/src/app/(app)/tickets/page.tsx:42 where `SortIconStatic` correctly accepts `{ col, sortKey, sortDir }`. The tasks/list/page.tsx should either (a) update the function signature to `function SortIconStatic({ k }: { k: SortKey })` and render directional chevrons, or (b) leave the call sites as `<SortIconStatic />` if a static icon is intentional.
suggestions: frontend/src/lib/store/auth-store.ts: The commit removes the `persist` middleware entirely, so auth state is now in-memory only and will be lost on page refresh. Confirm this is intentional — if persistence is still desired, a non-encrypted `persist` (without custom storage handlers) would be simpler and avoid the now-unused crypto-js dependency.

frontend/src/app/(app)/customers/page.tsx: `useEffect` removed from the import — verify that no `useEffect` calls remain in the file, otherwise this is a silent compile-time removal that could break runtime behavior.
